subject: Looking for a shiny/web developper to help on a project

messages.author: ed960445dd48c4c1
messages.subject: Looking for a shiny/web developper to help on a project
parts:
Hi,

My group has R scripts in a package that we would want to turn into a web app for people to access. We are a lab that work in the genetics of natural products.

The package has 3 main features, one of them is already in the form of a shiny app, the 2nd one is in the form of a R script that displays a static image as a result for now. The 3rd feature may be recycled from an existing webpage that we already have.
We would need somebody able to create a webpage as a portal to access all these features, turn the static R script of the 2nd features into a Shiny App, have all the shiny apps hosted (probably on shinyapps.io) etc... We have a very very tight time frame (4w maximum) to get this done.
The home page would also need to parse a fasta file of sequences that would be selected and the selected sequences would then be used for the different functions later on as a 'database'.

Please let me know if you are interested in the project.

Many thanks
Christophe
